name: calib_transmittance
_why: Absolute transmittance of a solid glass ball, with no reference renderer and no lighting model in the way. The backdrop is UNLIT, so its radiance IS its colour; the ball is index 1.5 and WHITE, so a ray through the ball's centre crosses two interfaces at normal incidence and bends at neither. The answer is therefore forced: (1 - F)^2 with F = ((1-n)/(1+n))^2 = 0.04, i.e. 0.9216, and nothing about the scene can move it. No lights, so the only thing being measured is transport. See transmittance_probe.py.
